definitions.explanation: A state of feeling sad, pessimistic, or emotionally down.

examples.japanese: {憂鬱|ゆううつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{憂鬱|ゆううつ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{憂鬱|ゆううつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

notes:
{憂鬱|ゆううつ} is a na-adjective and noun describing a state of feeling depressed, gloomy, or melancholic.

WRITING:
The character ⟦{鬱|うつ}→鬱：14706_utsu⟧ has 29 strokes, making it one of the most complex kanji in common use. Often written in hiragana (ゆううつ) or with the simplified variant {欝|うつ}.

- {憂鬱|ゆううつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become depressed
- {憂鬱|ゆううつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧: gloomy weather
